definitions.indexed_artifacts: Every entry in PROMPT_INDEX.json. A mixed population: domain prompts, agentic resources, and bundled component files. Not a prompt count.
definitions.bundled_component_files: Indexed entries with a assets/, cards/, evals/, fixtures/, references/, resources/, scripts/ directory between the top-level root and the filename. These are attachments of a parent resource, not resources in their own right.
definitions.agentic_resource_artifacts: Indexed entries under domain-agentic-resources/ that are not inside a bundled-component directory: skills, agents, commands, personas and the directory's own documentation.
definitions.domain_command_artifacts: Indexed entries outside domain-agentic-resources/ that sit in a commands/ directory. These are slash commands filed alongside a domain's prompts.
definitions.domain_prompt_artifacts: Indexed entries outside domain-agentic-resources/ that are neither inside a bundled-component directory nor inside a commands/ directory.
definitions.agents: Markdown files under domain-agentic-resources/agents/**, excluding README.md.
definitions.commands: Markdown files under domain-agentic-resources/commands/**, excluding README.md.
definitions.personas: Markdown files under domain-agentic-resources/personas/**, excluding README.md.
definitions.active_techniques: Non-deprecated technique IDs structurally defined in techniques/MASTER_TECHNIQUE_INDEX.md, as parsed by scripts/validate_technique_catalog.py.
definitions.catalogued_technique_ids: All technique IDs defined in the master index, active or deprecated.
definitions.deprecated_technique_stubs: Catalogued technique IDs marked deprecated or merged.
definitions.technique_categories: Distinct technique ID prefixes in the master index.
definitions.indexed_domain_directories: domain-* directories present in the DOMAIN_DIRS allowlist of scripts/generate_prompt_index.py, and therefore covered by PROMPT_INDEX.json.
definitions.unindexed_domain_directories: domain-* directories absent from that allowlist. Their content does not appear in PROMPT_INDEX.json and is excluded from every indexed count above.
